reviews.text: this serum gives a really nice, healthy glow to your skin. but I don’t think it’s hydrating enough for winter. now when it’s getting colder in Northern Europe I need to pair it with a good moisturiser. it is perfect for combo to oily skin, I would think. all in all definitely another 5 star product from purito. it works great under makeup.
reviews.zh: 呢款精華令皮膚有一種好健康嘅光澤。不過我覺得佢對冬天嚟講保濕力唔夠。而家北歐天氣越嚟越凍，我需要配一款好嘅保濕霜先用。我諗佢對混合性同油性皮膚嚟講最啱。總括嚟講，絕對係 purito 又一款五星好產品。佢喺化妝底下用效果好好。

reviews.text:
I can’t say anything about potential long-term effects of this serum as I have only been using it for a short period of time so far. 
I use it a couple of times a week as a first step of my morning routine in combination with (in order of application) Neogen’s Cica Repair Snail Essence and Purito’s Plainet Squalane Oil 100, followed with the Sur.Medic Super Ceramide 100 Renewal Cream to lock in all that goodness.
The serum has a thin gel consistency and seems to have no discernible smell. It spreads easily and absorbs quickly. I don’t know how effective it is but the combination of the 4 products seems to work well - my skin feels and looks great.
reviews.zh:
我暫時仲未可以評論呢款精華長期嘅效果，因為我用嘅時間仲短。我每星期用幾次，作為早上護膚嘅第一步，配合以下產品（按搽嘅次序）：Neogen 嘅 Cica Repair Snail Essence，以及 Purito 嘅 Plainet Squalane Oil 100，最後用 Sur.Medic Super Ceramide 100 Renewal Cream 鎖住所有保濕成分。
呢款精華質地係薄薄嘅啫喱，似乎冇明顯味道。推開好容易，吸收亦快。我唔知道佢效果有幾好，但四款產品一齊用，好似效果唔錯，我嘅皮膚感覺同睇落都好好。

reviews.text:
Moisturizer in the summer.I haven’t found anything I like as much. Love all the is PURITO products I’ve tried. Great for people with sensitive or breakout prone skin.

I have combination/sensitive/sometimes breakout prone skin and this does not irritate or break out my skin in any way. It soaks in quickly and always leaves my skin feeling hydrated. This is hydrating enough for me to use as a moisturizer in the summer.
reviews.zh:
夏天當保濕霜用。我未搵到其他更中意嘅產品。我試過嘅 PURITO 產品我都好鍾意。適合敏感或者易爆痘嘅皮膚。

我係混合、敏感、有時易爆痘嘅皮膚，呢款用起嚟唔會刺激，亦都唔會令我爆痘。好快吸收，用完皮膚一直都感覺水潤。夏天用，補濕效果已經足夠，我可以當保濕霜用。

reviews.text:
I loved the Purito Deep Sea different line so I was very excited to try serum from the deep sea line. 

For years I have searched and tried many products that hydrate without leaving a greasy feeling and appearance, but none were 100% compliant until I tried this one from PURITO.

It's refreshing, light, odorless, and works well with other skin care products. EXCELLENT!
reviews.zh:
我好鍾意 Purito Deep Sea 系列，所以好興奮試吓呢個系列嘅精華。

多年嚟，我試過好多補水產品，但冇一款可以做到完全唔油膩、唔黏膩，直到我試咗呢款 PURITO。

佢清爽、輕盈、冇味，同其他護膚品配合得好好。非常出色！

reviews.text: I love this product! It comes with a dropper with a rubber top applicator, so it's easy to use too much. At first, I was squeezing the top of the applicator, but now I wipe what comes out of the bottle directly in to my hand. It gives my skin more of an overall glow and is hydrating. I have mature skin, and this is one of the very few products that I honestly do feel makes a difference in my appearance.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款產品！佢配有一個附橡膠頂嘅滴管，所以好容易用多咗。我起初會擠滴管頂部，但而家我會直接將樽內嘅產品抹喺手心上。佢令我皮膚整體更有光澤，亦有補水效果。我屬成熟皮膚，呢款係少數真正令我覺得外觀有改善嘅產品。

reviews.text: I have been plagued by dark circles and puffy under eyes since my teen years and of everything I have tried this is the only product that works. I’ve noticed that it, purito droplet serum is moisturizing, reduces fine lines, and wrinkles. I have also noticed no irritation or acne from this products.In less than a week there was a very noticeable
reviews.zh: 由青少年時期開始，我一直受黑眼圈同眼袋困擾，試過所有方法，只有呢款產品有效。我留意到，purito droplet serum 會補濕，減少幼紋同皺紋。我亦冇因為呢款產品而出現刺激或者長痘。不到一個星期，已經出現非常明顯嘅

reviews.text: So I’ve had this product maybe 1weeks. I just noticed today. I have the usual sagging a little bit of dullness, but this has brighten my face, and lines are faded and my skin seems so much more plumper. It looks like I got a PRP micro needling treatment or some thing the skin is lifted more tight, the pores shrink, lines fading like folds it’s not just wrinkles butthe folds in my face. This is amazing and buy more products. .
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢款大概一個星期。我今日先留意到。我本身有啲鬆弛同暗啞嘅情況，但呢款令我面亮咗，紋路淡咗，皮膚亦感覺飽滿好多。睇落好似做咗 PRP 微針療程或者類似嘅嘢咁，皮膚更加緊緻，毛孔收細，紋路好似摺痕咁淡化，唔止係皺紋，仲係面上嘅摺位。呢個好驚人，我會再買更多產品。。

reviews.text: Listen I don't write reviews not unless it's a great product. I have under eye issues since is was a teenager...it runs in my family...now I'm 40 and eyes and face has gotten worse....so I came across their product and read the reviews but still not sure....I went for it and I am so glad I did...I noticed a difference in just two days!!
reviews.zh: 聽我講，除非係好產品，我先至會寫評論。我由青少年時期開始就有眼周問題……屋企人都有呢個問題……而家我40歲，眼同面都變得更差……所以我睇咗佢哋嘅產品同評論，但係仍然唔肯定……最後我決定試吓，真係好高興試咗，兩日之內就見到分別！！
